title: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz escalate
desc: Iran takes the offensive with attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and airstrikes on several countries around the Persian Gulf.

title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
desc: President Trump, Xi and Putin have met in Shenzhen for a historic trilateral meeting, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament on the agenda.

title: Infantino to face France's Diallo and Japan's Tashima in FIFA presidential election
desc: FIFA confirmed on Thursday that France's Philippe Diallo and Japan's Kozo Tashima will run against incumbent Gianni Infantino in next year's presidential election. Infantino has faced criticism since July over his aborted plan to sell stakes in World Cup profits to private investors.
